owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.amountUsdc6: Amount to deduct from user's tank and send to msg.sender (USDC 6 decimals).
params.user: The user whose DCA was executed.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

deposit(uint256).notice: User deposits USDC into their gas tank (6 decimals).

depositFor(address,uint256).notice: Deposit USDC into the gas tank on behalf of a user. Caller must have approved this contract. Used by vaults to fund user gas in one tx.

executor().notice: Relayer/executor address allowed to call recordExecution

gasCostPerExecutionUsdc6().notice: Gas cost per DCA execution in USDC (6 decimals). Editable by owner. E.g. $0.01 = 10_000.

recordExecution(address,uint256).notice: Executor (backend relayer) records gas cost for a user and gets reimbursed in USDC.

setGasCostPerExecution(uint256).notice: Set gas cost per execution in USDC (6 decimals). E.g. $0.01 = 10_000, $0.005 = 5_000.

withdraw(uint256).notice: User withdraws USDC from their gas tank.
